name: KAISER 3X

specs.notes: BMW's X3 M40i (G01, the 2021-2024 facelift): the B58 3.0 turbo straight six with a 48 V mild hybrid, 360 PS (265 kW) at 5,200-6,500 rpm and 500 N m at 1,900-5,000 rpm (BMW's technical data: 1,850-5,000 before the facelift; Autotijd for the facelift), xDrive, an eight-speed automatic, ~1,980 kg, 0-100 km/h in 4.9 s (4.8 before the facelift), 250 km/h limited; 382 hp in the US. Its torque curve follows those (from October 2026 to the cars' check it was drawn to the G45 X3 M50's 398 PS, and before that it held 580 N m to 5,500 rpm: 455 PS). Its ratios and aero are estimates.

garage.blurb: The sensible SUV with the silky six: quick, comfortable and four-wheel drive, the one you take when friends need a lift.

interior.notes: The model's own cabin: its steering wheel cut out to turn (tools/cars/x3_m40i.json), the eye placed by hand from section views; an automatic or dual clutch: the hands stay on the wheel.
